status: Specified before native simulations; retain failed cases and do not relax screens after observing results.

geometry.scope: Synthetic axisymmetric connected pore, same necks/interface region, body thickness and representative area; only interior radius changes. Both leads are numerical development sections and excluded from inferred body resistance. No reconstructed experimental specimen.

process.translation: Apply each measured body resistance / measured baseline body resistance to the published 3.12 m/h support impedance. One common baseline calibration; no design-specific fit. Use Zhu PDF-v2 effective non-support impedance and its reading range unchanged across designs. This is a literature-anchored scenario, not an absolute pore reconstruction or a viscosity-corrected experimental prediction.
process.scope: Transmembrane hydraulic-load shaft energy only. Constant inlet properties, linear flow, unchanged effective non-support impedance. Excludes circulation, fouling, osmotic pressure, backwash, motor losses, selectivity and strength certification. Actual DWSIM pump flowsheets; no native membrane separation unit.
